episodes.title: Camelot
episodes.summary: When the army pillages Sinaloa, an ambitious pot farmer pitches a plan to build a drug empire in Guadalajara. A young DEA agent transfers to Mexico.

episodes.title: The Plaza System
episodes.summary: Félix tries to unite all of the plazas while Rafa searches for water for his seedless weed. Police corruption and the DEA's complacency frustrate Kiki.

episodes.title: El Padrino
episodes.summary: Kiki flies solo on a risky undercover operation. Félix turns to his mentor for advice as conflict between the cops and the traffickers escalates.

episodes.title: Rafa, Rafa, Rafa!
episodes.summary: After months of frustration, Kiki seizes an opportunity. Rafa runs afoul of powerful government officials, putting Félix in a difficult position.

episodes.title: The Colombian Connection
episodes.summary: A threat leaves Mika shaken. Félix envisions a different kind of future for the Guadalajara cartel.

episodes.title: La Última Frontera
episodes.summary: A violent power struggle erupts between Falcón and Rafa. As Félix finds a footing in the cocaine business, the DEA tries to lure him into the U.S.

episodes.title: Jefe de Jefes
episodes.summary: María implores Félix to move back to Sinaloa. Kiki gathers evidence of the Guadalajara cartel's pot fields. Neto mourns.

episodes.title: Just Say No
episodes.summary: After the DEA closes in on Rafa's enormous pot field, Félix tries to stop his associates from retaliating. Kiki and Jaime meet with investigators.

episodes.title: 881 Lope de Vega
episodes.summary: A desperate Jaime is stymied by bureaucratic paperwork. Mika worries about her husband. Félix urges Rafa to disappear.

episodes.title: Leyenda
episodes.summary: As pressure mounts, Félix returns to Sinaloa. An enraged Jaime and Mika seek justice and answers.

episodes.title: Salva El Tigre
episodes.summary: While celebrating his 40th birthday, Félix worries about his associates' loyalty and confronts Pacho. Walt and his team plan retaliatory kidnappings.

episodes.title: Alea lacta Est
episodes.summary: Verdin taunts the DEA agents torturing him. Félix offers opium dealer Guerra a partnership deal. Benjamín's sister Enedina poses a new business idea.

episodes.title: Ruben Zuno Arce
episodes.summary: Multiple advisers counsel Félix to go into hiding as the Americans close in on the men involved in Kiki's murder. Amado helps Acosta resolve a feud.

episodes.title: The Big Dig
episodes.summary: Zuno testifies in front of a grand jury. Isabella tries to broker a deal with Enedina. Félix makes a daring offer to a U.S. contact.

episodes.title: AFO
episodes.summary: Calderoni briefs Walt on the tension between the plazas as Chapo continues construction of his tunnel. Félix's meeting with Pacho takes a turn.

episodes.title: El Dedazo
episodes.summary: Félix meets with a political leader. Benjamín takes a stand when the Sinaloa and Tijuana rivalry intensifies. Walt's team turns its attention to planes.

episodes.title: Truth and Reconciliation
episodes.summary: Félix proposes a new plan to help the PRI win the election and defeat Cárdenas. Promised intel on Félix, Walt takes an unexpected meeting in Ojinaga.

episodes.title: Se Cayó El Sistema
episodes.summary: Mexican authorities, the FBI and Félix all seek out Acosta after a newspaper publishes an interview with him. The presidential election begins.

episodes.title: Growth, Prosperity, and Liberation
episodes.summary: Félix stakes the future of his entire cartel on the delivery of 70 tons of cocaine as Walt and the DEA plan to topple the kingpin's empire.

episodes.title: Free Trade
episodes.summary: After meeting with Pacho, Félix presents the plaza bosses with a new business plan. Walt receives a surprising invitation.

episodes.title: 12 Steps
episodes.summary: Walt's undercover mission takes a turn. Amado is released following three months in prison. Juárez police officer Victor looks for a missing girl.

episodes.title: Como La Flor
episodes.summary: Tijuana journalist Andréa takes an interest in the teen guests at the wedding between Enedina Arellano and a prominent attorney. Walt considers a move.

episodes.title: Los Juniors
episodes.summary: After a disappointing conversation with the Arellanos about purchasing land, the Sinaloa cartel reacts. Andréa continues investigating the narcojuniors.

episodes.title: GDL
episodes.summary: With the Tijuana and Sinaloa cartels at war, everyone wonders where Juárez stands, but Amado has other plans in Cuba. Ramón seeks revenge against Chapo.

episodes.title: Boots on the Ground
episodes.summary: Walt joins a Mexican task force led by Gen. Rebollo aimed at catching those responsible for the Guadalajara massacre and Cardinal Posada's death.

episodes.title: La Jefa
episodes.summary: Victor is shaken by a murder and takes action. Violence escalates in Tijuana. New boss Enedina develops a plan to challenge her cartel's rivals.

episodes.title: La Voz
episodes.summary: La Voz is targeted following its reporting on Colosio's assassins. Mayo and Chapo form an alliance against the Tijuana cartel. Victor asks questions.

episodes.title: Last Dance
episodes.summary: When torturing Alex doesn't work, Walt switches tactics. Andrea sifts through financial records tied to Hank and the PRI. Amado plans for the future.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: Andrea uncovers a startling connection, instigating a cascade of events. With Alex's help, Walt closes in on Benjamín. Hank threatens Amado.

episodes.title: Life in Wartime
episodes.summary: Mexican and US authorities search in earnest for Amado. While in prison, Chapo makes moves to show he's the boss. Enedina sends Ramón on a mission.
